people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: I will wait for Yahweh, who hides his face from the house of Jacob, and I will look for him.
translations.bsb: I will wait for the LORD, who is hiding His face from the house of Jacob. I will put my trust in Him.
translations.kjv: And I will wait upon the LORD, that hideth his face from the house of Jacob, and I will look
translations.asv: And I will wait for Jehovah, that hideth his face from the house of Jacob, and I will look for him.
